evidence.sql: WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), hist AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, LAG(arr_usd, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prior_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN arr_usd > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY group_customer_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS had_positive_before FROM monthly ), classified AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, snapshot_month, arr_usd, prior_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 0 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS new_logo_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > prior_arr THEN arr_usd - prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS expansion_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND arr_usd < prior_arr THEN prior_arr - arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS contraction_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr > 0 AND arr_usd = 0 THEN prior_arr ELSE 0 END AS churned_arr, CASE WHEN YEAR(snapshot_month) = 2025 AND prior_arr = 0 AND arr_usd > 0 AND COALESCE(had_positive_before,0) = 1 THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END AS reactivation_arr FROM hist ), agg AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(new_logo_arr),2) AS new_logo_arr, ROUND(SUM(expansion_arr),2) AS expansion_arr, ROUND(SUM(contraction_arr),2) AS contraction_arr, ROUND(SUM(churned_arr),2) AS churned_arr, ROUND(SUM(reactivation_arr),2) AS reactivation_arr FROM classified ), begin_end AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS beginning_arr, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS ending_arr FROM monthly ) SELECT beginning_arr, new_logo_arr, expansion_arr, contraction_arr, churned_arr, reactivation_arr, ending_arr, ROUND(beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr,2) AS reconciled_ending_arr, ROUND(ending_arr - (beginning_arr + new_logo_arr + expansion_arr - contraction_arr - churned_arr + reactivation_arr),2) AS reconciliation_diff FROM begin_end CROSS JOIN agg

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id) AS group_customer_id, CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) AS snapshot_month, SUM(fsm.arr_usd) AS arr_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_subscription_month fsm JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fsm.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.parent_customer_id, c.customer_id), CAST(fsm.snapshot_month AS DATE) ), cohort AS ( SELECT group_customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS start_arr, MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2025-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) AS end_arr FROM monthly GROUP BY group_customer_id HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN snapshot_month = DATE'2024-12-01' THEN arr_usd ELSE 0 END) > 0 ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS starting_logo_count, ROUND(SUM(start_arr),2) AS starting_arr, ROUND(SUM(end_arr),2) AS ending_arr_for_starting_cohort, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_arr) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS nrr_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(LEAST(start_arr,end_arr)) / SUM(start_arr),2) AS grr_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_logo_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN end_arr = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),2) AS logo_churn_pct FROM cohort

WITH revenue_tagged AS ( SELECT YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS period_year, SUM(il.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(il.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND il.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND il.service_period_end IS NOT NULL THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_recurring_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND (il.service_period_start IS NULL OR il.service_period_end IS NULL) THEN il.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line il JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON il.product_id = p.product_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 GROUP BY YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ) SELECT period_year, ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * management_tagged_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS management_tagged_recurring_pct, ROUND(restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * restated_recurring_revenue / total_revenue,2) AS restated_recurring_pct, ROUND(management_tagged_recurring_revenue - restated_recurring_revenue,2) AS reclassified_revenue, ROUND(ambiguous_revenue,2) AS ambiguous_revenue FROM revenue_tagged

WITH invoice_base AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, i.customer_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, fc.amount_paid_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, fc.days_outstanding, fc.status AS collection_status FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ), paid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd IS NOT NULL ), unpaid AS ( SELECT * FROM invoice_base WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0) = 0 ), weighted AS ( SELECT ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd * days_outstanding) / SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS weighted_collection_days, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END),2) AS unpaid_invoice_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoice_count FROM invoice_base ) SELECT weighted_collection_days, unpaid_invoice_amount, unpaid_invoice_count FROM weighted

WITH invoice_status AS ( SELECT i.invoice_id, CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE) AS invoice_date, i.invoice_amount_usd, CAST(fc.payment_date AS DATE) AS payment_date, COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0) AS amount_paid_usd, CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN DATEDIFF(DATE'2025-12-31', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ELSE NULL END AS age_days FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id WHERE YEAR(CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) = 2025 ) SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count, ROUND(SUM(invoice_amount_usd),2) AS invoice_amount_usd FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 THEN 'paid' WHEN age_days <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN age_days <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN age_days <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NULL OR amount_paid_usd = 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'paid' AS bucket, invoice_amount_usd FROM invoice_status WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL AND amount_paid_usd > 0 ) x GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'paid' THEN 0 WHEN '1-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

WITH monthly_sales AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(invoice_amount_usd) AS monthly_sales FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(invoice_date AS DATE)) ), monthly_collections AS ( SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) AS month_start, SUM(CASE WHEN fc.payment_date IS NULL OR COALESCE(fc.amount_paid_usd,0)=0 THEN i.invoice_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid_invoiced_amount FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_collection fc ON i.invoice_id = fc.invoice_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(i.invoice_date AS DATE)) ), december AS ( SELECT ms.month_start, ms.monthly_sales, mc.unpaid_invoiced_amount, DAY(LAST_DAY(ms.month_start)) AS days_in_month FROM monthly_sales ms JOIN monthly_collections mc ON ms.month_start = mc.month_start WHERE ms.month_start = DATE'2025-12-01' ) SELECT ROUND(unpaid_invoiced_amount,2) AS ar_balance_proxy, ROUND(monthly_sales,2) AS sales_period_amount, days_in_month, ROUND((unpaid_invoiced_amount / monthly_sales) * days_in_month,2) AS dso_days_proxy FROM december

WITH x AS (SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_usd) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '' THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS restated_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN l.line_amount_usd ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN (LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(l.revenue_type,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND NOT ((LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%subscr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.delivery_model,'')) LIKE '%recurr%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(p.product_family,'')) LIKE '%subscr%') AND l.service_period_start IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(l.service_period_start) <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice_line l JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice i ON l.invoice_id=i.invoice_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_product p ON l.product_id=p.product_id WHERE year(to_date(i.invoice_date))=2025) SELECT ROUND(total_revenue,2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(tagged_revenue,2) AS tagged_revenue, ROUND(100*tagged_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS tagged_pct, ROUND(restated_revenue,2) AS restated_revenue, ROUND(100*restated_revenue/total_revenue,2) AS restated_pct, ROUND(tagged_failing_restated_amount,2) AS tagged_failing_restated_amount, tagged_failing_restated_lines FROM x
